campaign_tone_check.name: campaign_tone_check
campaign_tone_check.value: tone IS NULL OR tone IN ('heroic', 'lighthearted', 'tense', 'dark', 'mysterious', 'epic')

campaign_length_check.name: campaign_length_check
campaign_length_check.value: length IS NULL OR length IN ('one-shot', 'short', 'medium', 'long')

campaign_genre_flavor_check.name: campaign_genre_flavor_check

campaign_scale_check.name: campaign_scale_check

campaign_magic_level_check.name: campaign_magic_level_check

character_ability_method_check.name: character_ability_method_check
